articles.summary: “I sit on the panel for several banks and companies. The notice volumes are enormous, and every single one is on a deadline. I used to dread it. Now I hand Lexi the spreadsheet, and it drafts every notice straight from the facts in it, correctly, and ready to go in minutes.” Rishabh Gupta, Director at Gupta and Associates
articles.title: How a leading litigation firm turned a week of notice drafting into an afternoon's work
